title: Linear area formula with positive Gram determinant (Simon Ch. 2, 3.1)
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ and let L : ℝ^n → ℝ^P be an injective continuous linear map (ℝ^d = Euclid d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) with Hilbert adjoint L*. Then (i) det(L*∘L) > 0, where det is the determinant of the endomorphism L*∘L of ℝ^n (ContinuousLinearMap.det); and (ii) for every set S ⊆ ℝ^n (no measurability assumed), H^n(L(S)) = √det(L*∘L) · L^n(S) in [0, ∞], where H^n = μHE[n] on ℝ^P, L^n = volume on ℝ^n, and the factor is ENNReal.ofReal √det(L*∘L).
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (L : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P), Function.Injective L → 0 < (L.adjoint ∘L L).det ∧ ∀ S : Set (Euclid n), μHE[n] (L '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((L.adjoint ∘L L).det)) * volume S
